size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the list-users controller, which the prompt points at by naming GET /v1/users and the role query field.
prompt: GET /v1/users?role=user returns admins too: the role filter has no effect, while filtering by name works.

root_cause.detail: getUsers picks the filter key 'roles' instead of 'role' from the query, so ?role= is silently dropped.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users > should correctly apply filter on role field
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should correctly apply filter on role field'
